deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that these instructions are specific to Shopify's admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into your Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies"
2. Click on the "Return Policy" tab and scroll down to the "Return Reason" section
3. In this section, click on the "Add a return reason" button
4. A new window will appear where you can configure your return reason capture form settings
5. Select the type of return reason you want to capture (e.g., 'Reason for Return', 'Product Condition', etc.)
6. Choose how you want to display the return reason field on your returns page (e.g., as a dropdown, checkbox, or text input)
7. Configure any additional settings as needed (e.g., required fields, placeholder text, etc.)
8. Click "Save" to save your changes and exit the configuration window
9. To embed the return reason capture form into your returns flow, navigate to "Settings" > "Themes"
10. Click on the "Actions" dropdown menu next to your theme and select "Edit code"
11. In the code editor, navigate to the `templates/returns.liquid` file
12. Add the following Liquid code snippet to display the return reason capture form: `{% assign return_reason = settings.return_reason %} {{ return_reason | escape }}`
13. Save your changes and preview your returns page to test the embedded return reason capture form.
If you need further assistance, please refer to Shopify's official documentation for more information on customizing your returns flow.
